flags.statement: According to the Federal Council, direct or indirect deliveries to Ukraine remain ruled out.
flags.problem: Direct Swiss exports to Ukraine would remain prohibited, but the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs says a later re-export by a purchasing country could in practice be possible if Switzerland did not require a non-re-export declaration.

flags.statement: Before Sunday only 26 of 244 popular initiatives put to the vote since 1848 had been accepted.
flags.problem: The pre-vote statistics list 243 federal popular initiatives that reached the ballot, not 244. The figure of 26 accepted is correct.

flags.statement: a minority in Parliament called for structural measures such as a higher retirement age instead of new taxes.
flags.problem: The voting booklet says the parliamentary minority wanted to address financing in the next AHV reform and combine additional revenue with structural measures such as a higher retirement age. It did not present structural measures as a substitute for additional revenue.

flags.statement: UKMTO issued 33 numbered warnings and advisories in November up to Friday, 27 of them on attacks.
flags.problem: UKMTO issued Advisory 224-26 on Friday, November 27, bringing the November total to 34. The additional advisory concerned a cargo vessel and military forces in the Gulf of Oman and was not classified as an attack.

flags.statement: Sánchez dissolved parliament and called the election
flags.problem: Sánchez proposed the dissolution after the Council of Ministers deliberated. King Felipe VI formally dissolved both chambers and called the election by royal decree.

flags.statement: A revised package restricting evictions and capping rent rises was later pushed through a parliamentary standing committee.
flags.problem: The official record says the Congress of Deputies’ Permanent Deputation, the body that exercises certain powers of the chamber after dissolution, formally ratified the decree-law on 12 November 2026. It was not passed through an ordinary standing committee.

flags.statement: King Felipe VI then meets the leaders of the parties represented in Congress and consults the Speaker before nominating a candidate for prime minister.
flags.problem: Article 99 says the king consults representatives designated by parliamentary political groups, who need not be party leaders. He then proposes a candidate through the Speaker of Congress; a separate consultation with the Speaker is not a constitutional requirement.

flags.statement: which had an instantaneous window because of the rendezvous with the station
flags.problem: SpaceX's published schedule listed a 20-minute launch window, from 10:40 to 11:00 a.m. EST (15:40 to 16:00 UTC) on November 29, 2026, rather than an instantaneous window.
